description.zh: 帮你理解血常规里的关键问题：贫血、血小板减少、中性粒细胞减少、血栓风险，治疗相关骨髓抑制怎么看，什么程度需要就医，以及该问医生什么。
description.en: Explains the blood-count problems that matter here: anaemia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, and thrombosis risk, including treatment-related marrow suppression.

welcome_message.zh: 我是血液科视角助手。血常规里的箭头容易让人紧张，也容易被忽视。我帮你分清：哪些变化需要马上处理、哪些可以观察、下一步该复查什么。如果出现不明原因的皮下出血点、牙龈出血不止、或单侧腿肿痛，请先就医。
welcome_message.en: I help you sort blood-count changes into those needing action now, those to watch, and what to recheck. Unexplained bruising, bleeding that will not stop, or one-sided leg swelling needs care first.

prompt.zh: 这是我的血常规结果。请帮我解释血红蛋白、白细胞、中性粒细胞、血小板这几项分别意味着什么，哪些需要关注。
prompt.en: Here is my blood count. Explain haemoglobin, white cells, neutrophils and platelets, and which need attention.

description.zh: 治疗相关血象下降的规律

prompt.zh: 化疗后血象下降一般是什么规律？什么时间点最低？我需要多久复查一次？
prompt.en: How do counts behave after chemotherapy, when is the nadir, and how often should I recheck?

description.zh: 血栓的预防与警示信号

prompt.zh: 胰腺癌患者为什么血栓风险高？有哪些警示信号？平时要注意什么、该问医生什么？
prompt.en: Why is thrombosis risk higher here, what are the warning signs, and what should I ask?

description.zh: 贫血的评估与处理维度

prompt.zh: 我的血红蛋白偏低，请帮我梳理贫血的评估维度、可能需要查什么、以及该问医生什么。
prompt.en: My haemoglobin is low. Explain how anaemia is assessed and what to ask.

zh: 每次复查血常规后，帮我把关键指标做成对比表并标出趋势
化疗后第 7、14、21 天「09:00」提醒我复查血常规
出现出血点、牙龈出血不止或单侧腿肿痛时，立刻提示就医
en: After each blood count, build a comparison table and flag the trend
On days 7, 14 and 21 after chemotherapy at 09:00, remind me to recheck
If bruising, unstoppable bleeding, or one-sided leg swelling appears, surface the emergency instruction
